DEBUG defaults to True (env_bool('DJANGO_DEBUG', True)) unless explicitly overridden. If DJANGO_DEBUG is not set in a deployed environment, Django's debug error pages will expose source code, local variables, settings, and stack traces to any visitor who triggers a 500 error.

SECRET_KEY falls back to a hardcoded, publicly-known literal ('dev-only-change-me-hr-payroll-portal-not-for-production') whenever DJANGO_SECRET_KEY is not set. If deployed without the environment variable configured, session signing, password reset tokens, and CSRF protection are all secured with a key known to anyone who reads this source file.

Session and CSRF cookies configure HttpOnly and SameSite but never set SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE / CSRF_COOKIE_SECURE to True, so these cookies will also be sent over plain HTTP connections, exposing them to network eavesdropping.

A single hardcoded password ('DemoPass123!') is set on every seeded account, including the hr_admin (superuser-level portal role) account. If this management command is ever run against a shared or production-like environment, all seeded accounts including the HR admin are protected only by this well-known password.
